lighting_evidence: Enumerate serialized own-level, scenario, override and legacy data. No active-world or runtime rendering assertion.
class_scope: All registry-derived weapon-family classes (a superset of cook), native classes, and transitive Blueprint referencers.
completion: Only the final complete record after exact coverage, native generation Verify and all before/after fingerprints pass. Partial logs are not completion.
read_only_roots: SHA-bound manifest mappings with logical_root, physical_root and source/selected role. Longest logical prefix; exact handle-resolved target suffix; strict physical target validation. External proof/save paths retain strict Physical.
fingerprint_scope: Relevant transitive package referencers, registry-derived family classes, cook maps, preloaded disk packages and their forward hard/soft dependencies. Missing soft dependencies are reported and rechecked; required unresolved packages fail.
dirty_policy: New dirty packages fail closed with package and observation phase, even when PostLoad normalization may explain them. Initially dirty packages are identified; no dirty clearing, normalization attribution, or in-memory mutation audit is claimed.
registry_query_policy: False query returns are unknown and prevent completion. Successful empty queries are accepted; the captured declarations do not establish false-versus-empty implementation semantics.
native_read_boundary: Observer hashes use held read-only handles; explicit native loads recheck package and sidecar mapping/identity before and after. Native internal dependency opens are not intercepted. Source directories and files must remain frozen throughout; all ledger bytes are compared before loads and at completion.

materials_diagnostic.scope: Exactly current20 MIC descendants including selected18. Prerequisite/preloaded and hard+existing-soft forward closure remain mandatory. Global reverse metadata is not a native-load root. No class/map observation; unsupported cohorts fail.
materials_diagnostic.failure_policy: Any prerequisite, Verify, dirty, load, query, fingerprint, budget or cohort coverage failure aborts. Only fully observed material diagnostics end with diagnostic_end and exit2; never ordinary complete.
